full_judgment: 2. The respondent, as plaintiff, filed Title Suit No. 35 of 1997 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Matlab, Chandpur seeking permanent injunction on the averments that 8.77 acres of land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 34, including the suit plot, belonged to Banga Chandra, Mohon Bashi, Noda Bashi and Hari Bashi in ejmali shares of whom Noda Bashi having died unmarried, the three surviving brothers got his share; 5.22 acres of land of plot No. 1222 of the suit khatian also belonged to the 'said' three, surviving brothers 'in equal share of 1.74 acres each; from his 1.74 acres of land Banga sold 1.20 acres to Amir Hossain on 13-11-1828 and sold remaining 0.54 acres to Shamsher Ali and Serajuddin Bepari on 13-11-1928 who in turn sold 24 decimals of land to Dorajuddin in the year 1948; Shamsher Ali and Serajuddin thereafter on 2-3-1948 executed a deed of gift/ Nadabipatra in favour of Dorajuddin in respect of 76 decimals of land and then on 15-1-1995 Amir Hossain and 'his mother' sold 0.80 acres to Dorajuddin and though the defendants have no right; title, interest and possession in the suit land they on 30-5-1997 threatened to dispossess the plaintiffs from the suit land and hence the suit.
